messages:
Priya: Hi folks, I received a jury summons for 2026-12-29 to 2027-01-03 which overlaps the company year-end shutdown. How does that interact with the blackout and PTO carryover rules?
Sam - People Ops: Thanks for the heads-up, Priya. We have a jury duty exception. Can you upload a PDF of the summons to the HR portal or email people-ops@redwood.ai so we can process it? :eyes:
Priya: Yep uploaded the pdf and also emailed it. Subject: 'Jury summons - Priya'.
people-ops-bot: Request received. Ticket #PO-5987 created. Attachments: jury_summons.pdf. Expect review in 1-2 business days.
Nina (Legal): Quick note: in many jurisdictions jury duty is protected leave. We typically mark those days as company-protected and they should not count against carryover. We'll confirm based on the summons dates.
Sam - People Ops: Policy excerpt: `Jury duty during company shutdown will be treated as an excused absence and exempt from PTO blackout and carryover deductions upon receipt of official documentation.`
Priya: Do I need to request PTO for travel or childcare on the days before/after?
Sam - People Ops: No need to book PTO for the jury dates themselves once we exempt them. For travel/childcare days adjacent to jury duty, please submit a PTO request and note the reason; managers can approve those separately.
Mark (Eng Manager): I can cover standups those days and move tasks off Priya's plate. If you want a calendar hold that shows you're out, I can approve tentative unpaid leave so teams aren't scheduling on top of it.
Priya: Appreciate that. Also curious about pay: is jury duty paid or unpaid?
Nina (Legal): Redwood provides jury duty pay per the regional policy: employees on jury duty during company shutdown receive regular pay for scheduled workdays. State law may also provide a jury stipend; payroll will reconcile any stipend with company pay. We'll confirm once People Ops notifies payroll.
Sam - People Ops: We'll flag payroll after review. If you want us to mark the dates now as protected and keep your PTO balance intact, reply "Protect dates" here and we'll proceed.
Priya: Protect dates. Thanks everyone.
people-ops-bot: Action queued: protect absence dates pending verification. Ticket #PO-5987 updated.
Sam - People Ops: Got it. We'll send confirmation email once payroll signs off (likely by EOD tomorrow). Thanks for sending the summons. :white_check_mark:
